stories.title: China warns US sanctions on Iran will intensify tensions
stories.reason: Beijing vowed 'all necessary measures' to protect its Iran ties, drawing a major power directly into the sanctions standoff days before Xi's planned Washington visit.

stories.title: Canada announces targeted countermeasures and $7.5B in support for workers and businesses
stories.reason: Ottawa formalized dollar-for-dollar retaliatory tariffs on US steel, dairy, and electronics effective September 8, plus a loan package for affected industries.

stories.title: Strikes in Gaza kill 4, including 2 children, a week after US asked Israel to curb attacks
stories.reason: The strikes come despite explicit US pressure to reduce attacks, raising questions about Washington's influence over the ceasefire's enforcement.

stories.title: Apple unveils a more powerful Mac mini featuring the all-new M6 and M5 Pro
stories.reason: Apple's first 2nm chip lands in a surprise refresh of the Mac mini and Mac Studio, with the M6 promising up to 4x faster AI performance.

stories.title: Stock market today: Nasdaq, Russell 2000 climb ahead of Nvidia earnings, Fed symposium
stories.reason: Markets rebounded on falling yields and chip-stock strength as investors position for Wednesday's Nvidia earnings and the Fed's next policy signal.

stories.title: DeepSeek enters the multimodal AI race with an experimental vision model
stories.reason: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp reportedly approaches Claude Opus 4.8 on multimodal agent benchmarks, intensifying competition from Chinese labs.
